Details: Replaced separate Edit/Copy buttons with a single \⋯\" button (no border). Click opens dropdown with Edit and Copy; Copy shows \"Copied\" briefly. Click-outside closes menu."
Scrollbar now visible when messages exceed viewport height. Arrow-key scroll unchanged.
Sidebar (New chat, Bare Acts, etc.) can be resized via strip on right edge (↔ cursor). Default width 210px; range 140px–420px.
Eval Results + Architecture pane resizable via strip at top (↕ cursor). Default ~6px (collapsed); can extend up to 75% of viewport. Drag up = expand, down = collapse.
Per-dispute bare-act sections capped (e.g. 3 per dispute, 12 overall) to avoid flooding UI; web doc enrichment limited for speed.
Added STRUCTURED_FINAL_OPINION_BY_DISPUTE_PROMPT in advocate_prompts; legal opinion uses dispute-wise structure.

Single accordion for Eval Results, Architecture, and Updates Tracker (one open at a time). Updates Tracker loads table from UPDATES_TRACKER.csv in Frontend/public. Disclaimer shown only when no bottom section is expanded. Headers at top; expanded section uses remaining space with pane scrollbar.
Reduced vertical space between messages. Three-dots actions (⋯) kept at end of message text on same line. User messages limited to ~55% of chat width with light blue background and border.

Case law file naming standardized to 'SC_YYYY_Appellant Name versus Respondent Name' for Supreme Court and 'HC_YYYY_Appellant Name versus Respondent Name' for High Courts; filename generation logic in retrieval updated accordingly.

Opinion structured dispute-wise (Dispute 1, Dispute 2, etc.) with each bare act section explained in plain language and important provisions shown in monospaced boxes. Follow-up question now asked once at the end, only when the answer would genuinely change which sections apply or their severity; otherwise the assistant offers to fetch case law or give a full legal opinion.
